targets.query: SELECT last("value") FROM "electrical.batteries.Engine.voltage"
SELECT last("value") FROM "electrical.batteries.House.voltage" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT last("value") FROM "electrical.batteries.Engine.voltage" WHERE $timeFilter  ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT last("value") FROM "electrical.batteries.Thruster.voltage" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT last("value") FROM "electrical.batteries.House.current" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("value") * -1 FROM "electrical.batteries.House.load" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("value") FROM "electrical.batteries.House.capacity.stateOfCharge" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (last("value") -273) * 9/5 + 32 FROM "electrical.batteries.House.temperature" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT last("value") FROM "tanks.freshWater.front.currentLevel" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT last("value") FROM "tanks.freshWater.aft.currentLevel" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT last("value") FROM "tanks.fuel.main.currentLevel" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT last("value") * 60 FROM "propulsion.main.revolutions" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (((last("value") - 273) * 1.8) +32) FROM "propulsion.main.coolantTemperature" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (((last("value") - 273) * 1.8) +32) FROM "propulsion.main.exhaustTemperature" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (((last("value") - 273) * 1.8) +32) FROM "environment.inside.mainCabin.temperature" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (((last("value") - 273) * 1.8) +32) FROM "environment.inside.refrigerator.temperature" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT last("value") FROM "environment.inside.mainCabin.voc" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT last("value") FROM "navigation.attitude.heel" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (last("value")) FROM "environment.inside.mainCabin.humidity" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT (last("value")) FROM "environment.inside.mainCabin.pressure" WHERE $timeFilter ORDER BY DESC LIMIT 1
select last(stringValue) from "navigation.datetime"
select last(stringValue) from "environment.ssid"
select last(value) from "sensors.bilge.count"
select last(stringValue) from "sensors.bilge.time"
SELECT last("lat") as "lat", last("lon") as "lon" FROM "navigation.position" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
SELECT mean("value") *1.944 as "SOG" FROM "navigation.speedOverGround" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(linear)
SELECT mean("value") *180/3.14159 as "COG" FROM "navigation.courseOverGroundTrue" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
